text.en:
Scoring <pve 1 /> <pvp [3] /> kills with <stasis/>Stasis Weapons, Abilities, or <stasis/>Shatter spawns a <stasis/>'Diamond Lance' at the enemy's death location. Enters a <pve 7 /> <pvp [17] /> second cooldown upon creation.

<stasis/>Diamond Lance stays on the ground for 25 seconds, and lasts for 10 seconds upon pickup. 

Throwing the Lance with [Fire] launches it forward, <stasis/>Freezing enemies and <stasis/>Shattering <stasis/>Stasis Crystals within a 5 meters radius of its impact.

Pressing [Melee] will instead slam the lance onto the ground below you, <stasis/>Freezing enemies within an <pve 8 /> <pvp [5?] /> meter radius and <stasis/>Shattering any <stasis/>Stasis Crystals it damages. Slamming the <stasis/>Diamond Lance grants you and allies within a ? meter radius x2 <stasis/>Frost Armor.
